title: Berberine Ameliorates High-fat-induced Insulin Resistance in HepG2 Cells by Modulating PPARs Signaling Pathway.
authors: Zhang, Lingxiao; Yang, Chenghao; Ding, Xinyue; Zhang, Hui; Luan, Yuling; Tang, Yueer; Liu, Zongjun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱通过PPAR信号通路改善胰岛素抵抗，仅涉及分子对接验证小分子-蛋白互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Berberine (BBR), also known as berberine hydrochloride, was isolated from the rhizomes of the Coptis chinensis. Studies have reported that BBR plays an important role in glycolipid metabolism, including insulin resistance (IR). The targets, and molecular mechanisms of BBR against hyperlipid-induced IR is worthy to be further studied. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The related targets of BBR were identified via Pharmmapper database and relevant targets of diabetes were obtained through GeneCards and Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM) database. The common targets were employed with the STRING database and visualized with the protein-protein interactions (PPI) network. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis was performed to explore the biological progress and pathways. In vitro, human hepatocellular carcinomas (HepG2) cell was used as experimental cell line, and an insulin resistant HepG2 cell model (IR-HepG2) was constructed using free fatty acid induction. After intervention with BBR, glucose consumption and uptake in HepG2 cells were observed. Molecular docking was used to test the interaction between BBR and key targets, and real-time fluorescence quantitative PCR was used to detect the regulatory effect of BBR on related targets. RESULTS: 262 overlapped targets were extracted from BBR and diabetes. In the KEGG enrichment analysis, the peroxisome proliferator activated receptor (PPAR) signaling pathway was included. In vitro experiments, BBR can significantly increase sugar consumption and uptake in IR HepG2 cells, while PPAR inhibitors can weaken the effect of BBR on IR-HepG2. CONCLUSION: The PPAR signaling pathway is one of the important pathways for BBR to improve high-fat-induced insulin resistance in HepG2 cells.
abstract_zh: 背景：小檗碱（Berberine，BBR），又称盐酸小檗碱，是从黄连根茎中分离得到的。研究报道，BBR在糖脂代谢中发挥重要作用，包括胰岛素抵抗（insulin resistance，IR）。BBR对抗高脂诱导的IR的靶点及分子机制值得进一步研究。材料与方法：通过Pharmmapper数据库鉴定BBR的相关靶点，并通过GeneCards和在线人类孟德尔遗传（Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man，OMIM）数据库获取糖尿病的相关靶点。共同靶点使用STRING数据库进行分析，并通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interactions，PPI）网络进行可视化。进行基因本体论（Gene Ontology，GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes，KEGG）富集分析，以探索生物学过程和通路。在体外实验中，使用人肝细胞癌（human hepatocellular carcinomas，HepG2）细胞系作为实验细胞，并通过游离脂肪酸诱导构建胰岛素抵抗HepG2细胞模型（IR-HepG2）。经BBR干预后，观察HepG2细胞的葡萄糖消耗和摄取情况。使用分子对接测试BBR与关键靶点之间的相互作用，并使用实时荧光定量PCR检测BBR对相关靶点的调控作用。结果：从BBR和糖尿病中提取出262个重叠靶点。在KEGG富集分析中，包括过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（peroxisome proliferator activated receptor，PPAR）信号通路。在体外实验中，BBR能显著增加IR-HepG2细胞的糖消耗和摄取，而PPAR抑制剂能减弱BBR对IR-HepG2的作用。结论：PPAR信号通路是BBR改善HepG2细胞中高脂诱导胰岛素抵抗的重要通路之一。
